verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's docs show first-class ingestion of traces, logs, and metrics via OpenTelemetry/OTLP, a unified Query Builder with relational span fields (root./parent./child.) to pivot across trace data, and BubbleUp/Boards for cross-signal investigation — supporting the 'one platform, shared context' story. However, independent community evidence (honeycomb-comm-4) shows a real SRE team still splitting traces (Honeycomb), logs (OpenSearch), and metrics (Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics) across separate tools rather than fully unifying in Honeycomb, suggesting the pivot-with-shared-context experience is not always achieved end-to-end in practice. missing for 10: hands-on demonstration of pivoting seamlessly between logs/metrics/traces within a single Honeycomb UI, and stronger independent corroboration that metrics ingestion/correlation is as mature as traces.
